if getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup then
    pcall(getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup)
    getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup = nil
end

if getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary then
    pcall(function()
        getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary:Unload()
    end)
    getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary = nil
end

local libraryUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/croksyscript/CrypticLoader/refs/heads/main/Obsidian/Obsidian_UI/Obsidian_UI.lua"

local success, Library = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet(libraryUrl))()
end)

if not success or not Library then
    return
end

getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary = Library

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Packets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packets"))
local minigameActive = PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("IS_MINIGAME_ACTIVE")

local okFood, FoodData = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FoodData"))
local okMoney, FormatMoney = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FormatMoney"))

local PoopUI = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("PoopUI")
local lineTrigger = PoopUI:WaitForChild("CatchBar"):WaitForChild("LineTrigger")
local slider = PoopUI.CatchBar:WaitForChild("BarLine"):WaitForChild("Slider")
local target = slider:WaitForChild("Target")

local BACKPACK_LIMIT = 300

local state = {
    running = true,
    notifications = {},
    remotePoop = false,
    legitPoop = false,
    instantLine = false,
    remoteDelay = 1,
    pause = 2,
    cycles = 0,
    autoSell = false,
    sellMode = "Poop Count",
    sellValue = 100,
    sellAction = "Sell All",
    sellOneMode = "First",
    lastSell = os.clock(),
    autoBuy = false,
    buyInterval = 10,
    selectedFoods = {},
    stock = {},
}

local connections = {}

local function jitter(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

local function formatMoney(value)
    if okMoney and typeof(value) == "number" then
        local ok, text = pcall(FormatMoney, value, true)
        if ok then
            return text
        end
    end
    return tostring(value)
end

local function isPoop(tool)
    return tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:sub(1, 4) == "Poop"
end

local function getPoops()
    local list = {}
    for _, tool in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if isPoop(tool) then
            table.insert(list, tool)
        end
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if held and isPoop(held) then
        table.insert(list, held)
    end
    return list
end

local function getBackpackSize()
    return #LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()
end

local function getWeight(tool)
    return tonumber(tool.Name:match("([%d%.]+)%s*lb")) or 0
end

local CLICK_LATENCY = 0.05

local lastCenter = 0
local lastTime = os.clock()

local function isLineInTarget()
    local now = os.clock()
    local center = lineTrigger.AbsolutePosition.X + lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local elapsed = math.max(now - lastTime, 1 / 240)
    local velocity = (center - lastCenter) / elapsed
    lastCenter = center
    lastTime = now
    local predicted = center + velocity * CLICK_LATENCY
    local margin = lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.065
    local left = target.AbsolutePosition.X
    return left - margin < predicted and predicted < left + target.AbsoluteSize.X + margin
end

local function sendMouse(position, down)
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(position.X, position.Y, 0, down, game, 0)
end

local CLICK_SPOTS = {}

for _, x in ipairs({ 0.04, 0.96, 0.08, 0.92 }) do
    for _, y in ipairs({ 0.35, 0.5, 0.25, 0.65, 0.75 }) do
        table.insert(CLICK_SPOTS, Vector2.new(x, y))
    end
end

local function isSpotFree(point)
    local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    for _, gui in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X - inset.X, point.Y - inset.Y)) do
        if not gui:IsDescendantOf(PoopUI) and (gui:IsA("GuiButton") or gui.Active) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function getFreePoint()
    local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    for _, spot in ipairs(CLICK_SPOTS) do
        local point = size * spot
        if isSpotFree(point) then
            return point
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function clickTrigger()
    local position = getFreePoint()
    if not position then
        return
    end
    sendMouse(position, true)
    task.wait(0.03)
    sendMouse(position, false)
end

local function getChargeFill()
    local chargeUi = workspace:FindFirstChild("ChargeUI")
    local bar = chargeUi and chargeUi:FindFirstChild("BarProgress", true)
    return bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Fill")
end

local function chargeBar()
    local position = getFreePoint()
    if not position then
        task.wait(1)
        return
    end
    sendMouse(position, true)
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local fill
    repeat
        task.wait()
        fill = getChargeFill()
    until fill or os.clock() - startTime > 0.5
    while os.clock() - startTime < 2 do
        if fill and fill.Parent and fill.Size.Y.Scale >= 0.97 then
            break
        end
        if not fill and os.clock() - startTime >= 0.7 then
            break
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    sendMouse(position, false)
end

local targetAspect = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
local defaultAspectRatio = targetAspect and targetAspect.AspectRatio
local WIDE_ASPECT_RATIO = 4

local function moveTargetToLine()
    local lineCenter = lineTrigger.AbsolutePosition.X + lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local targetCenter = target.AbsolutePosition.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local position = slider.Position
    slider.Position = UDim2.new(position.X.Scale, position.X.Offset + lineCenter - targetCenter, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset)
end

local function widenTarget()
    if targetAspect then
        targetAspect.AspectRatio = WIDE_ASPECT_RATIO
    end
end

local function restoreTarget()
    if targetAspect then
        targetAspect.AspectRatio = defaultAspectRatio
    end
end

local function runLegitCycle()
    if not minigameActive.Value then
        chargeBar()
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 30
    while state.running and minigameActive.Value and os.clock() < deadline do
        if state.instantLine then
            widenTarget()
            moveTargetToLine()
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            moveTargetToLine()
            clickTrigger()
            task.wait(jitter(0.2, 0.3))
        elseif isLineInTarget() then
            clickTrigger()
            task.wait(jitter(0.4, 0.55))
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    restoreTarget()
    state.cycles += 1
    task.wait(state.pause * jitter(0.85, 1.25))
end

local function runRemoteCycle()
    Packets.RequestPoop:Fire()
    state.cycles += 1
    local delay = state.remoteDelay * jitter(0.8, 1.35)
    if math.random() < 0.05 then
        delay += jitter(2, 4)
    end
    task.wait(delay)
end

local function pickPoop(mode)
    local poops = getPoops()
    if #poops == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    if mode == "Held" then
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        return held and isPoop(held) and held or nil
    end
    if mode == "Smallest" or mode == "Biggest" then
        table.sort(poops, function(a, b)
            if mode == "Smallest" then
                return getWeight(a) < getWeight(b)
            end
            return getWeight(a) > getWeight(b)
        end)
    end
    return poops[1]
end

local function sellOne(mode)
    local tool = pickPoop(mode)
    local uuid = tool and tool:GetAttribute("uniquePoopID")
    if not uuid then
        return false
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Packets.SellCurrentlyHeldPoop:Fire(uuid)
    end)
    if ok then
        Library:Notify("Sold poop for " .. formatMoney(result), 3)
    end
    return ok
end

local function sellAll()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Packets.SellInventory:Fire()
    end)
    if ok then
        state.lastSell = os.clock()
        Library:Notify("Sold inventory for " .. formatMoney(result), 3)
    end
    return ok
end

local function runSell()
    if state.sellAction == "Sell One" then
        return sellOne(state.sellOneMode == "Held" and "First" or state.sellOneMode)
    end
    return sellAll()
end

local function refreshStock()
    pcall(function()
        Packets.FoodStock:Fire()
    end)
end

local function buyFood(name)
    pcall(function()
        Packets.PurchaseFood:Fire(name)
    end)
end

local function getFoodNames()
    local names = {}
    if okFood and typeof(FoodData) == "table" then
        for name in pairs(FoodData) do
            table.insert(names, name)
        end
        table.sort(names, function(a, b)
            return FoodData[a].Price < FoodData[b].Price
        end)
    end
    return names
end

local function getStockText()
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(state.stock) do
        table.insert(names, name)
    end
    table.sort(names)
    return #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "Nothing"
end

table.insert(connections, Packets.FoodStock.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(list)
    state.stock = {}
    if typeof(list) == "table" then
        for _, name in ipairs(list) do
            state.stock[name] = true
        end
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, Packets.PurchaseFood.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(purchased, name)
    if purchased then
        state.stock[name] = nil
        table.insert(state.notifications, "Bought " .. tostring(name))
    end
end))

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local hasSpace = getBackpackSize() < BACKPACK_LIMIT
        local cycle = nil
        if hasSpace and state.remotePoop then
            cycle = runRemoteCycle
        elseif state.legitPoop and (hasSpace or minigameActive.Value) then
            cycle = runLegitCycle
        end
        if cycle then
            local ok = pcall(cycle)
            if not ok then
                task.wait(1)
            end
        else
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        if state.autoSell then
            if state.sellMode == "Seconds" then
                if os.clock() - state.lastSell >= state.sellValue then
                    state.lastSell = os.clock()
                    runSell()
                end
            elseif #getPoops() >= state.sellValue then
                runSell()
                task.wait(2)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local text = table.remove(state.notifications, 1)
        if text then
            Library:Notify(text, 3)
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
end)

local lastBuyCheck = 0

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local due = os.clock() - lastBuyCheck >= state.buyInterval
        if state.autoBuy and due and next(state.selectedFoods) then
            lastBuyCheck = os.clock()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.selectedFoods) do
                if state.stock[name] then
                    buyFood(name)
                    task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local Window = Library:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Open Source - Poop a Big Poop",
    Footer = ".gg/XDpsSW7Ybs",

        Tooltip = "Charges the bar and clicks the minigame like a player",
        Callback = function(value)

            if value and Library.Toggles.RemotePoopToggle.Value then

    })

    Box:AddToggle("InstantLineToggle", {

        while state.running do

            sizeLabel:SetText(("Inventory: %d / %d"):format(getBackpackSize(), BACKPACK_LIMIT))

local function buildSellTab(Tab)
    local Manual = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Left",
        Name = "Manual Sell",
        IconName = "hand-coins",
    })

    Manual:AddButton({
        Text = "Sell All Poops",
        Func = sellAll,
    })

    Manual:AddDropdown("SellOneMode", {
        Text = "Sell One Mode",
        Values = { "First", "Smallest", "Biggest", "Held" },
        Default = 1,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellOneMode = value
        end,
    })

    Manual:AddButton({
        Text = "Sell One Poop",
        Func = function()
            if not sellOne(state.sellOneMode) then
                Library:Notify("No matching poop found", 3)
            end
        end,
    })

    local Auto = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Right",
        Name = "Auto Sell",
        IconName = "repeat",

    Auto:AddToggle("AutoSellToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Sell",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.autoSell = value
            state.lastSell = os.clock()
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddDropdown("AutoSellMode", {
        Text = "Sell Trigger",
        Values = { "Poop Count", "Seconds" },
        Default = 1,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellMode = value
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddInput("AutoSellValue", {
        Text = "Poops or Seconds",
        Default = "100",
        Numeric = true,
        Finished = true,
        Placeholder = "100",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellValue = math.max(tonumber(value) or 1, 1)
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddDropdown("AutoSellAction", {
        Text = "Sell Action",
        Values = { "Sell All", "Sell One" },
        Default = 1,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.sellAction = value
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddLabel({

end

local function buildFoodTab(Tab)
    local Buy = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Left",
        Name = "Buy Food",
        IconName = "shopping-cart",
    })

    Buy:AddDropdown("FoodSelect", {
        Text = "Foods",
        Values = getFoodNames(),
        Default = {},
        Multi = true,
        AllowNull = true,
        SelectAllButtons = true,
        Callback = function(values)
            state.selectedFoods = {}
            for name, enabled in pairs(values) do
                if enabled then
                    state.selectedFoods[name] = true
                end
            end
        end,
    })

    Buy:AddButton({
        Text = "Buy Selected Once",
        Func = function()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.selectedFoods) do
                if state.stock[name] then
                    buyFood(name)
                    task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
                else
                    Library:Notify(name .. " is out of stock", 3)
                end
            end
        end,
    })

    Buy:AddButton({
        Text = "Buy Everything In Stock",
        Func = function()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.stock) do
                buyFood(name)
                task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
            end
        end,
    })

    local Auto = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Right",
        Name = "Auto Buy",
        IconName = "repeat",
    })

    Auto:AddToggle("AutoBuyToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Buy Selected",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            state.autoBuy = value
        end,
    })

    Auto:AddSlider("BuyInterval", {
        Text = "Check Stock Every",
        Default = 10,
        Min = 5,
        Max = 60,
        Rounding = 0,
        Suffix = "s",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.buyInterval = value
        end,
    })

    local stockLabel = Auto:AddLabel({
        Text = "In Stock: Nothing",
        DoesWrap = true,
    })

    task.spawn(function()
        while state.running do
            stockLabel:SetText("In Stock: " .. getStockText())
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    refreshStock()
end

local Tabs = {
    Poop = Window:AddTab("Poop", "zap"),
    Sell = Window:AddTab("Sell", "hand-coins"),
    Food = Window:AddTab("Food", "shopping-cart"),
}

buildPoopTab(Tabs.Poop)
buildSellTab(Tabs.Sell)
buildFoodTab(Tabs.Food)

local function cleanup()
    state.running = false
    state.remotePoop = false
    state.legitPoop = false
    state.autoSell = false
    state.autoBuy = false
    restoreTarget()
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    connections = {}
end

getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup = cleanup
Library:OnUnload(cleanup)

-- Fly Script + Vehicle Fly + Noclip + GUI (executor version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ============ STATE ============
local flying = false
local speed = 60
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro, flyConnection

local noclipEnabled = false
local noclipConnection

local vehicleFlyEnabled = false
local vehicleFlyActive = false
local vehicleBodyVelocity, vehicleBodyGyro
local vehicleRoot
local vehicleRenderConnection
local vehicleMonitorConnection
local savedCameraSubject
local savedCameraType

local ui = {}
local connections = {}

-- ============ FORWARD DECLARATIONS ============
local updateFlyButton
local updateNoclipButton
local updateVehicleFlyButton

local function track(conn)
    connections[#connections + 1] = conn
    return conn
end
local function disconnectAll()
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    connections = {}
end

-- ============ ANTI-RAGDOLL ============
local RAGDOLL_STATES = {
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
}
local function disableRagdollStates(h)
    for _, s in ipairs(RAGDOLL_STATES) do
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(s, false) end)
    end
end
local function restoreRagdollStates(h)
    for _, s in ipairs(RAGDOLL_STATES) do
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(s, true) end)
    end
end

-- ============ CHARACTER FLY ============
local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or flying then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
    if humanoid.Sit then return end

    flying = true
    disableRagdollStates(humanoid)
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = hrp

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.D = 500
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then return end
        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local camCF = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and (dir.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                    restoreRagdollStates(humanoid)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- ============ NOCLIP ============
local function startNoclip()
    if noclipEnabled then return end
    noclipEnabled = true
    noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function stopNoclip()
    noclipEnabled = false
    if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() noclipConnection = nil end

-- ============ VEHICLE FLY ============
local function getSeatAndRoot()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil end
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or not humanoid.Sit then return nil, nil end
    local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
    if not seat then return nil, nil end
    local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local root = (model and model.PrimaryPart) or seat
    return seat, root
end

local function startVehicleFly()
    if vehicleFlyActive then return end
    local seat, root = getSeatAndRoot()
    if not seat or not root then return end
    vehicleRoot = root
    vehicleFlyActive = true

    if flying then stopFly() end

    vehicleBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    vehicleBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    vehicleBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    vehicleBodyVelocity.Parent = vehicleRoot

    vehicleBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    vehicleBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    vehicleBodyGyro.P = 10000
    vehicleBodyGyro.D = 500
    vehicleBodyGyro.CFrame = vehicleRoot.CFrame
    vehicleBodyGyro.Parent = vehicleRoot

    -- ----- SIMPLE CAMERA FIX -----
    -- Just retarget the camera to the vehicle chassis. The default camera
    -- script handles smoothing itself; no Scriptable mode, no fighting.
    savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject
    savedCameraType = camera.CameraType
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    camera.CameraSubject = vehicleRoot

    local yaw = 0
    local lastUpdate = 0

    vehicleRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not vehicleFlyActive or not vehicleRoot or not vehicleRoot.Parent then return end

        -- Re-assert camera subject in case the engine resets it while seated
        if camera.CameraSubject ~= vehicleRoot then
            camera.CameraSubject = vehicleRoot
        end

        -- Yaw from camera so movement is camera-relative
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)

        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local camCF = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

        vehicleBodyVelocity.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and (dir.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        -- Flat yaw-only orientation so the vehicle doesn't tumble
        vehicleBodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(vehicleRoot.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    end)
end

local function stopVehicleFly()
    if not vehicleFlyActive then
        -- Still restore camera in case something got left over
        if savedCameraSubject then
            camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            savedCameraSubject = nil
        end
        return
    end
    vehicleFlyActive = false

    if vehicleRenderConnection then vehicleRenderConnection:Disconnect() vehicleRenderConnection = nil end
    if vehicleBodyVelocity then vehicleBodyVelocity:Destroy() vehicleBodyVelocity = nil end
    if vehicleBodyGyro then vehicleBodyGyro:Destroy() vehicleBodyGyro = nil end
    vehicleRoot = nil

    -- Restore camera
    local char = player.Character
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    camera.CameraType = savedCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
    camera.CameraSubject = humanoid or savedCameraSubject
    savedCameraSubject = nil
    savedCameraType = nil
end

local function refreshVehicleMonitor()
    if vehicleMonitorConnection then
        vehicleMonitorConnection:Disconnect()
        vehicleMonitorConnection = nil
    end
    if not vehicleFlyEnabled then
        if vehicleFlyActive then stopVehicleFly() end
        return
    end
    vehicleMonitorConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local _, root = getSeatAndRoot()
        if root then
            if not vehicleFlyActive then startVehicleFly() end
        else
            if vehicleFlyActive then stopVehicleFly() end
        end
    end)
end

local function toggleVehicleFly()
    vehicleFlyEnabled = not vehicleFlyEnabled
    refreshVehicleMonitor()
    if updateVehicleFlyButton then updateVehicleFlyButton() end

-- ВСТАВЬ СВОИ ID АНИМАЦИЙ (см. инструкцию после скрипта)
local FLY_ANIM_ID    = "rbxassetid://0"  -- полёт (движение)
local HOVER_ANIM_ID  = "rbxassetid://0"  -- парение (стоит на месте)
local WIND_SOUND_ID  = "rbxassetid://3308152153" -- звук ветра (этот рабочий)

local function addHighlight(char)
    if not ESP_ON then return end
    if not char or not char:IsA("Model") then return end
    if char:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight") then return end

    local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.Name                = "ESPHighlight"
    h.FillColor           = ESP_FILL_COLOR
    h.OutlineColor        = ESP_OUTLINE_COLOR
    h.FillTransparency    = 0.5
    h.OutlineTransparency = 0

end

local function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Character then
            local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight")
            if h then h:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end

local function hookPlayer(p)
    if p == player then return end
    if p.Character then addHighlight(p.Character) end
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(addHighlight)
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hookPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)

local function setESP(state)
    ESP_ON = state
    if ESP_ON then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= player and p.Character then addHighlight(p.Character) end
        end
    else

    end

--============================================================
--  FLY
--============================================================
local flying, hrp, humanoid, att, lv, vf, spin, connFly

local isMoving = false
local loadedAnimator = nil

local function loadAnimations()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local animator = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not animator then
                animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                animator.Parent = hum
            end
        end
    end
    if not animator then return end
    loadedAnimator = animator

    local flyAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    flyAnim.AnimationId = FLY_ANIM_ID
    flyAnimTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(flyAnim)
    flyAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

    local hoverAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    hoverAnim.AnimationId = HOVER_ANIM_ID
    hoverAnimTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(hoverAnim)
    hoverAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

    if windSound then windSound:Destroy() end

    windSound.Volume = 0.5
    windSound.Parent = hrp

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if connFly then connFly:Disconnect() connFly = nil end
    if lv  then lv:Destroy()  lv  = nil end
    if vf  then vf:Destroy()  vf  = nil end
    if spin then spin:Destroy() spin = nil end
    if att then att:Destroy() att = nil end

    if flyAnimTrack then flyAnimTrack:Stop() flyAnimTrack = nil end
    if hoverAnimTrack then hoverAnimTrack:Stop() hoverAnimTrack = nil end
    if windSound then windSound:Stop() windSound:Destroy() windSound = nil end

    if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end

    hrp, humanoid = nil, nil
    currentVel = Vector3.zero

end

local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    hrp      = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)

    att = Instance.new("Attachment")

    vf = Instance.new("VectorForce")

    vf.RelativeTo  = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World

    lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")

    lv.MaxForce    = math.huge
    lv.RelativeTo  = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
    lv.Parent = hrp

    spin = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    spin.Attachment0    = att
    spin.Mode           = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    spin.MaxTorque      = math.huge
    spin.Responsiveness = 20
    spin.Parent         = hrp

    currentVel = Vector3.zero
    isMoving = false

    loadAnimations()

    if hoverAnimTrack then
        pcall(function() hoverAnimTrack:Play(0.2) end)
    end

    connFly = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not flying or not hrp or not hrp.Parent or not lv then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end

        local look  = cam.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = cam.CFrame.RightVector

        local move = Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit end

        local movingNow = move.Magnitude > 0
        if movingNow ~= isMoving then
            isMoving = movingNow
            if isMoving then
                if hoverAnimTrack then pcall(function() hoverAnimTrack:Stop(0.2) end) end
                if flyAnimTrack and not flyAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
                    pcall(function() flyAnimTrack:Play(0.2) end)
                end
            else

                if hoverAnimTrack and not hoverAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
                    pcall(function() hoverAnimTrack:Play(0.2) end)
                end
            end
        end

        if windSound then
            if movingNow and not windSound.IsPlaying then
                windSound:Play()
            elseif not movingNow and windSound.IsPlaying then

            end
        end

        local speed = FLY_SPEED
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
        or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then

        end

        local targetVel = move * speed
        currentVel = currentVel:Lerp(targetVel, math.clamp(FLY_ACCEL * dt, 0, 1))
        lv.VectorVelocity = currentVel

        spin.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + look)
    end)

local function giveTeleportTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack or backpack:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") or char:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") then return end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Mouse.Hit then
            local currentRotation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * currentRotation
        end
    end)

end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then floatPlatform:Destroy() floatPlatform = nil end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY or math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, floatBaseY + floatYOffset, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

local function updateSpectateTracer()
    if not spectatingPlayer or not spectatingPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP or not targetHRP then removeSpectateTracer() return end

    if not spectateBeam or not spectateBeam.Parent then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        
        spectateAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment") spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP
        spectateAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment") spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP

        spectateBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        spectateBeam.Attachment0 = spectateAtt0
        spectateBeam.Attachment1 = spectateAtt1
        spectateBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170))
        spectateBeam.Width0 = 0.08
        spectateBeam.Width1 = 0.08
        spectateBeam.FaceCamera = true
        spectateBeam.LightEmission = 1
        spectateBeam.Parent = myHRP
    else
        if spectateAtt1 and spectateAtt1.Parent ~= targetHRP then
            spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP
        end
    end
end

                local timeStr = os.date("%I:%M:%S %p")

                local labels = {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(deathLogs) do table.insert(labels, entry.label) end
                deathDropdown:SetValues(labels)
            end
        end))
    end

    if player.Character then onCharacter(player.Character) end
    table.insert(connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter))

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Настройки по умолчанию
local Config = {
    AutoFarm = false,
    FlySpeed = 60, -- Значение от 0 до 500
    AutoKey = true -- Искать ключ и открывать дверь или просто сразу лететь к двери
}

-- Игровые папки DOORS
local CurrentRooms = Workspace:WaitForChild("CurrentRooms")
local GameData = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameData")

-- Вспомогательная функция перемещения через CFrame
local function moveToCFrame(targetCFrame)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

    humanoid.PlatformStand = true

    while Config.AutoFarm and (hrp.Position - targetCFrame.Position).Magnitude > 2 do
        if not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
        
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        
        -- Полет прямо в точку со заданной скоростью
        local dir = (targetCFrame.Position - hrp.Position).Unit
        local newPos = hrp.Position + (dir * (Config.FlySpeed * RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()))
        
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos + dir)
    end
    
    if not Config.AutoFarm and humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

-- Функция поиска текущей двери
local function getLatestDoor()
    local latestRoomNum = GameData.LatestRoom.Value
    local room = CurrentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(latestRoomNum))
    if room then
        local door = room:FindFirstChild("Door")
        if door then
            return door, room
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

-- Поиск ключа в комнате
local function getKeyInRoom(room)
    for _, item in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
        if item.Name == "KeyObtain" or item.Name == "Key" then
            local prompt = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
            return item, prompt
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

-- Главный поток автофарма
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if Config.AutoFarm then
            local door, room = getLatestDoor()
            if door and room then
                local doorPart = door:FindFirstChild("Door") or door:FindFirstChild("PrimaryPart") or door
                local lock = door:FindFirstChild("Lock")
                
                -- Если есть замок и включен AutoKey
                if lock and Config.AutoKey then
                    local key, prompt = getKeyInRoom(room)
                    if key then
                        local keyPart = key:IsA("BasePart") and key or key:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if keyPart then
                            -- Летим к ключу
                            moveToCFrame(keyPart.CFrame)
                            
                            -- Забираем ключ
                            if prompt then
                                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.3)
                        end
                    end
                end
                
                -- Летим к двери
                if doorPart then
                    moveToCFrame(doorPart.CFrame)
                    
                    -- Открываем дверь / поворачиваем ручку
                    local doorPrompt = door:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
                    if doorPrompt then
                        fireproximityprompt(doorPrompt)
                    end
                    
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
